modelReview.summary: The analysis is not reproducible due to missing raw data and code. The manuscript omits essential statistical details (effect sizes, missingness handling, diagnostics) and contains inaccurate reporting of p-values. These issues prevent final acceptance.

findings.title: No raw data or analysis code provided; analysis not reproducible
findings.whyItMatters: Without access to the raw data and the exact code used to produce the analysis, independent verification of results is impossible, undermining the scientific value of the report.
findings.actionableFix: Provide the raw dataset (anonymized if needed) and the complete analysis pipeline (code, configuration, environment) in the run directory or a public repository. Ensure the manuscript states data availability.

findings.title: Effect sizes not reported for ANCOVA
findings.whyItMatters: P-values alone do not convey the magnitude or practical importance of group differences. Readers cannot assess whether the group effect is negligible or potentially meaningful despite non-significance.
findings.actionableFix: Report appropriate effect size measures (e.g., partial eta-squared, omega-squared) with confidence intervals for the group term. Discuss the observed effect size in the context of clinical/public-health relevance.

findings.title: Missing data handling not described; complete-case analysis may be biased
evidenceRefs: manuscript.md mentions 'complete-case records' but no details
findings.whyItMatters: If missingness depends on variables in the model or unmeasured confounders, complete-case analysis can yield biased estimates. Readers cannot evaluate the risk of selection bias.
findings.actionableFix: Describe the extent and pattern of missing data: how many records were excluded per variable, reasons for missingness, and sensitivity analyses (if feasible). Compare baseline characteristics of included vs. excluded records.

findings.title: Model diagnostics not presented in manuscript
findings.whyItMatters: Assumptions of ANCOVA (normality of residuals, homoscedasticity, linearity, influential points) must be verified for valid inference. The manuscript should confirm that assumptions were checked and met.
findings.actionableFix: Incorporate a paragraph in Methods/Results summarizing diagnostic checks: Shapiro-Wilk test for normality of residuals (p=0.79), max leverage (0.05), max Cook's distance (0.05), and VIF (<1.35) indicating no severe violations. Discuss any potential issues.

findings.title: P-values for covariates inappropriately reported as '0.0000'
evidenceRefs: manuscript.md: 'For age, the F statistic was 212.0550; p=0.0000.'
findings.whyItMatters: Reporting very small p-values as 0.0000 misrepresents the uncertainty and precision; it implies a probability of exactly zero, which is incorrect. This is a violation of standard reporting guidelines.
findings.actionableFix: Report p-values to a consistent number of significant digits, e.g., p < 0.0001, or use scientific notation (p = 1.1e-34). Avoid reporting exactly zero.

findings.title: Inconsistency between QA status and manuscript advisory issues statement
evidenceRefs: manuscript.md: 'The methods review found advisory issues that need human review. The analysis is not ready for stronger claims until the advisory methods issues are reviewed.'
findings.whyItMatters: The manuscript suggests unresolved methodological concerns, but the automated QA found no errors. This discrepancy may confuse readers and implies potential hidden problems that are not specified.
findings.actionableFix: Either remove the advisory-issues statement if no real issues exist, or clearly list the specific methodological concerns (e.g., missingness, effect size) so they can be addressed.

findings.title: No literature context or comparison
findings.whyItMatters: Even for a local analysis, situating findings within existing knowledge helps assess consistency and novelty. The complete absence of any reference to prior work weakens the scientific contribution.
findings.actionableFix: Add a brief literature review or at least note that no comparable studies exist. If the analysis is purely exploratory, state that explicitly and discuss how results align with known effects of age, severity, etc.

findings.title: Figure content not verifiable in review package
evidenceRefs: figure-qa.json and anova-group-distribution.png only referenced by hash
findings.whyItMatters: Without seeing the actual figure and its QA report, the reviewer cannot assess whether the figure accurately represents the data and is free of distortions or misleading elements.
findings.actionableFix: Include the rendered figure image (e.g., png) and the full figure QA JSON content in the review packet. Ensure the figure adequately displays group differences with appropriate error bars or confidence intervals.
